import zipfile
import shutil
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_new.xlsx'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as z:
    entries = {n: z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}

# ---------- sheet1.xml ----------
root = ET.fromstring(entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'])

dim = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}dimension')
dim.set('ref', 'A1:H10')

cols = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}cols')
if cols is not None:
    col_h = ET.SubElement(cols, f'{{{NS}}}col')
    col_h.set('width', '12')
    col_h.set('customWidth', '1')
    col_h.set('min', '8')
    col_h.set('max', '8')

sheet_data = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}sheetData')

def add_cell(row_el, ref, style=None, formula=None, text=None):
    c = ET.SubElement(row_el, f'{{{NS}}}c')
    c.set('r', ref)
    if style:
        c.set('s', style)
    if formula:
        f = ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}f')
        f.text = formula
        ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}v')
    elif text is not None:
        c.set('t', 'inlineStr')
        is_el = ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}is')
        t = ET.SubElement(is_el, f'{{{NS}}}t')
        t.text = text
    return c

for row in sheet_data.findall(f'{{{NS}}}row'):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    if r == 1:
        add_cell(row, 'H1', style='1', text='Profit Margin %')
    elif 2 <= r <= 10:
        add_cell(row, f'H{r}', style='3', formula=f'G{r}/E{r}')

# ---------- styles.xml ----------
sroot = ET.fromstring(entries['xl/styles.xml'])
numfmts = sroot.find(f'{{{NS}}}numFmts')
numfmts.set('count', '1')
nf = ET.SubElement(numfmts, f'{{{NS}}}numFmt')
nf.set('numFmtId', '164')
nf.set('formatCode', '0.0%')

cellxfs = sroot.find(f'{{{NS}}}cellXfs')
cellxfs.set('count', str(int(cellxfs.get('count')) + 1))
xf = ET.SubElement(cellxfs, f'{{{NS}}}xf')
xf.set('numFmtId', '164')
xf.set('fontId', '0')
xf.set('fillId', '0')
xf.set('borderId', '0')
xf.set('xfId', '0')
xf.set('applyNumberFormat', '1')

entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = ET.tostring(root, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8')
entries['xl/styles.xml'] = ET.tostring(sroot, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8')

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for name, data in entries.items():
        z.writestr(name, data)

shutil.move(TMP, SRC)
print('written', SRC)

import subprocess, sys
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', 'openpyxl'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("returncode:", r.returncode)
print(r.stdout[-2000:])
print(r.stderr[-2000:])
